# bizkit_webhook_endpoint (Resource)

A public URL that stores every request it gets, and can forward each one on.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bizkit_webhook_endpoint" "stripe" {
  project_id  = bizkit_project.website.id
  name        = "Stripe"
  forward_url = "https://api.example.com/hooks/stripe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name.
- `project_id` (String) The project it belongs to. Changing it replaces the endpoint.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Disabled endpoints answer 404 and store nothing. Defaults to `true`.
- `forward_url` (String) Where each captured request is sent on. Public addresses only. Write it as bizkit normalizes URLs (a bare origin ends in `/`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The endpoint ID, also its public address.
- `url` (String) The public URL that captures requests.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by ID.
tofu import bizkit_webhook_endpoint.example <id>
```
